title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Verification Timing Allowance
content:
When pay for orders verified as not delivered is taken back on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the verification timing allowance is subtracted from the not-delivered orders' share of the mileage posting once any share multiplying it has been applied, and the amount is never below zero. The allowance is counted in calendar days from the batch's completion date to the date of the latest wrong-address violation recorded against the batch on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record:

| Calendar days from completion date to the latest wrong-address violation | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Zero (same day) | 0.15 |
| One to three | 0.10 |
| Four or more | Nothing |

Where more than one wrong-address violation is recorded against the batch, the latest of them sets the count.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, batch completed 12 August)

| Latest wrong-address violation dated | Days | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 12 August | 0 | 0.15 |
| 13 August | 1 | 0.10 |
| 15 August | 3 | 0.10 |
| 16 August | 4 | Nothing |

Hypothetical: violations dated 12 August and 16 August against the same batch count from the later one, 16 August, so no allowance.
